while with /break and /continue, and /goto loops.
-- origin --
spec
-- script.mrc --
alias test {
  var %i = 1
  while (%i <= 10) {
    inc %i
    if (%i == 3) continue
    if (%i > 5) break
    echo -s while %i
  }
  var %x = 1
  :next
  echo -s item %x
  inc %x
  if (%x < 4) goto next
}
-- output --
while 2
while 4
while 5
item 1
item 2
item 3
